newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-CAGLIARI STRIKER BANCHELLI OUT FOR SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CAGLIARI STRIKER BANCHELLI OUT FOR SEASON.

text.p: Cagliari striker Giacomo Banchelli, scorer of three goals in five starts with the serie A club, will miss the rest of the season after damaging cruciate ligaments in his left knee.
The club said the 23-year-old, injured on the stroke of halftime against Napoli last weekend, would take at least six months to recover from surgery.
